195:t_005:12.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, begin your attack. Stop the transport and strike $$ターミナル・ベース$$.」

195:t_005:13.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's go! Listen to my song!!」

195:t_006:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Damn it! Don't think this is enough to bring down my castle!」

195:t_007:0.en:
$$シン$$
「They still had that many left!?」

195:t_007:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Ha ha ha! In battle, you must think two or three moves ahead! Behold my brilliant tactics!」

195:t_007:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then let me show you the move I prepared four moves ahead.」

195:t_008:1.en:
$$ギミー$$
「We finally joined $c, but I thought we'd never get our turn!」

195:t_008:2.en:
$$ダリー$$
「$$ギミー$$! Standing by as a separate force in case of emergencies is an important mission too!」

195:t_008:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Damn it, there aren't many of them! Scatter them at once!」

195:t_008:4.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Sorry. We aren't the ones who'll be taking on your trump card.」

195:t_009:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's something that will shake your very existence from its foundations...」

195:t_010:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-impossible! The ground collapsed in an instant!?」

195:t_010:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「This is a piece of cake for my drill!」

195:t_011:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$シモン$$, $$ヴィラル$$! You guys were here too!?」

195:t_011:2.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「We were fighting $$サイデリアル$$ on this continent too.」

195:t_011:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「We got word through $$ロシウ$$ and came here to join $c.」

195:t_011:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then I had them stand by as reserve forces.」

195:t_011:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
「D-damn you! An ambush is cowardly!」

195:t_011:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「You've got some nerve saying that!」

195:t_011:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Nothing's lamer than a guy who criticizes everyone else and ignores what he does himself!」

195:t_011:9.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Sorry to pile on when you're already down, but...」

195:t_011:10.en:
$$チコ$$
「You've got even more enemies coming.」

195:t_012:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You transported it through quantization!?」

195:t_012:1.en:
$$チコ$$
「That's right. This is the power of the $$トップレス$$.」

195:t_012:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You're awfully late, Princess. Where did you stop along the way?」

195:t_012:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Undoing the seal took a while. I don't know what they were doing, but it was bound up in cables.」

195:t_012:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「She should be coming out soon.」

195:t_014:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$タカヤ・ノリコ$$ and $$ガンバスター$$... are returning to the front as of this moment!」

195:t_014:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's $$ガンバスター$$. One of our comrades pilots it.」

195:t_014:5.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I see... So that's the mysterious $$バスターマシン$$ we've heard about.」

195:t_014:7.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I'm going up front! I have no intention of babysitting anyone!」

195:t_014:8.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...Won't you do this for me?」

195:t_015:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I've come this far, so I'll see you through to the end. Do what you like.」

195:t_015:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Don't get the wrong idea just because Big Sis was a little nice to you!」

195:t_015:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ノノ$$! When did you get into $$ディスヌフ$$!?」

195:t_015:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Never mind that, Big Sis! Please don't let that girl beat you!」

195:t_015:7.en:
$$ラルク$$
「But $$ニコラ$$ told me to back her up.」

195:t_015:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I-it's so frustrating...! If only $$ノノ$$ had a $$バスターマシン$$ too...!」

195:t_015:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「They seem to be arguing right after meeting each other...」

195:t_015:11.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...Sorry I kept you waiting, $$ガンバスター$$... But...」

195:t_016:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We'll make up for it by giving 120% from here on!」

195:t_016:2.en:
$$バサラ$$
「That's a great shout, $$ノリコ$$!」

195:t_016:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「I can feel her hard work and guts from here!」

195:t_016:4.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「We can't let her beat us, $$シモン$$.」

195:t_016:6.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Leave the backup to me, $$シモン$$!」

195:t_017:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$バサラ$$ and $$ガムリン$$, the $$大グレン団$$ and $$ガンバスター$$...」

195:t_017:1.en:
$n
「We've gathered this much strength! I can't see us losing!」

195:t_017:3.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You're awfully quiet, $$ギルター・ベローネ$$.」

195:t_017:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This is your punishment for terrorizing people with force! Now let an even greater force crush you!」

195:t_017:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's go, everyone! We'll wipe them out in one go!」

195:t_017:6.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$! We'll never give up!」

195:t_017:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We'll defeat you and bring peace back to this Earth!!」

195:t_018:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「All enemy units except the transport have been shot down.」

195:t_018:1.en:
$$ラム$$
「The remaining transport has transmitted its surrender.」
